whoWeAre.headline: Who We Are
whoWeAre.paragraph1: Innovative Thermal Solutions is a leading turnkey engineering firm specializing in the design and manufacture of air-cooled heat sinks and liquid cold plates for power electronics, RF generators, and battery packs.
whoWeAre.paragraph2: We combine in-house CFD thermal simulation, 5-axis CNC machining, and production-scale friction stir welding under one roof in Guelph, Ontario to take assemblies from concept to volume production.

workflow.headline: From “what if”
workflow.description: Thermal and mechanical design, simulation, manufacturing and testing. Connected from the very first conversation.

steps.title: Define & discover
steps.description: Start with your heat load, temperature targets, available space and production goals. We turn the constraints into a clear design brief.
steps.caption: DEFINE REQUIREMENTS & CONSTRAINTS.

steps.title: Design & simulate
steps.description: CFD, parametric studies and iterative optimization explore the thermal design. SolidWorks supports mechanical design and integration.
steps.caption: THERMAL & HYDRAULIC ANALYSIS.

steps.title: Machine & manufacture
steps.description: Five-axis CNC machining and friction stir welding bring the design to life at our Ontario facility, with trusted partners for high-volume production.
steps.caption: PRECISION MANUFACTURING. IN HOUSE.

steps.title: Test & deliver
steps.description: Experiments and prototype evaluation check thermal performance against your project requirements before moving toward production.
steps.caption: FROM PROTOTYPE TO PRODUCTION.

manufacturing.subtitle: Hermetic solid-state joining and precision thermal manufacturing under one roof in Guelph, Ontario.
